Chapter 9: buses and numbers (13 levels)

The first chapter on the way to the 32-bit CPU: from putting eight
wires on a bus and taking it apart again, masks and flipping bits, to
the 8-bit adder from full adders, negation in two's complement,
subtraction, zero test, equality, less-than by subtraction, shifting,
a 4-way selector and the 8-bit ALU. Every level checks with formulas
on numbers and makes a chip the next ones build on (ADD8, SUB8, ZERO8,
EQ8, SEL4, ALU8), with a three-star model solution laid by the router.
The tests no longer count chapters and levels by hand.
